openStreetMap.note: Use an allowed tile provider or self-hosted tiles for production/bulk/offline use.

openSeaMap.note: Attribute OpenSeaMap/OpenStreetMap and follow tile/data terms.

gebco.note: Official GEBCO WMS; current service is based on GEBCO 2026.

carto.note: Public tiles are subject to CARTO service terms and attribution.

avenzaStyleOffline.note: Only use maps/data for which the user or operator has rights.

radar.note: A phone cannot become a physical marine radar through software alone.

batnas.note: Enable only after authorized dataset access is confirmed.

bmkg.note: Automated access must use the official API. Commercial third-party integration requires written permission.

jarvisOpenRouter.apiKeyStorage: user-configured local storage; never hard-code in APK

aisLive.note: Do not put provider secrets in the APK bundle. Use a server/native secure gateway.

radarHardware.note: Requires compatible onboard radar hardware and network gateway.

navionicsGarmin.note: Requires Garmin approval, SDK, developer token and applicable chart/content rights.

marineTrafficApi.note: MarineTraffic API services are separately authorized; current MarineTraffic/Kpler products may differ by service.

windyApi.note: Use the current official Windy API and terms. Never ship a private API key in public APK code.

windyMap.note: Full API parity requires the applicable Windy API access/terms.

garminActiveCaptain.note: SDK gratis/open-source, tetapi Garmin Developer Portal access + Stage API key diperlukan untuk Community data. Do not ship secret in web assets.

aisStream.note: Public real-time AIS WebSocket. Key must remain server-side; direct browser connection is not allowed by provider.

globalFishingWatch.note: Dynamic vessel activity/identity/history and fishing-effort datasets; API key and attribution required. Use as supplemental intelligence, not as guaranteed second-by-second AIS.

noaaMarineCadastreAIS.note: Public U.S. AIS historical/quarterly datasets; useful for traffic history and heatmaps, not global realtime.

emodnetBathymetry.note: Public bathymetry web services; not a live navigation chart and mainly European/global products depending layer.

noaaErddap.note: Public oceanographic datasets such as satellite/buoy observations; dataset freshness varies.

indonesiaDataGoId.note: Public Indonesian government datasets; freshness varies by dataset.

kkpData.note: KKP public data portal including WPP and fisheries datasets.
